Formated COD_COUVERTURE_EPIBIONT column to the dataframe

format_epibiont.Rd

This categorizes AND includes the of the following definition: ave_coverage to cod_couverture : 0 -> Aucune balane 1 -> 1/3 et moins surface colonisée 2 -> 1/3 à 2/3 surface colonisée 3 -> 2/3 et plus surface colonisée

Usage

format_epibiont(capt, andes_db_connection, code_filter)

Arguments

capt

Dataframe

andes_db_connection

A connection object to the ANDES database.

code_filter

a list of species code to filter on, or NULL for no filtering

Value

The input dataframe with columns for categorical codes

Details

#' ave_with_barnacles to cod_abondance 0 -> Aucun des pétoncles ne porte de balane 1 -> 1 2 -> 21 3 -> 41 4 -> 61 5 -> 81
